headline: Steady Buy consensus, climbing off its low
chart_note: 52-week range: $146.32 - $269.11. Currently $247.55, up sharply from its low and closing in on its high.
why_today: Salesforce shares have climbed roughly 69% off their 52-week low, recovering as enterprise software spending stabilizes and its AI-agent push (Agentforce) gains traction with customers. Consensus remains a solid Buy.
pro_1: 56 analysts rate it Buy, average price target of $273 implies further upside from here
pro_2: Sharp recovery off the 52-week low shows renewed investor confidence in the AI-agent growth story
con_1: PE of 22.6x prices in continued execution on Agentforce - any stumble could hit hard given the recent run-up
con_2: Enterprise software spending is still sensitive to broader corporate budget tightening
